claimText: Instrument flight procedures aligning aircraft with the extended runway centre line for dependent parallel approaches must be a precision approach procedure, an APV procedure using RNP AR APCH (with specific RNP value constraints), or an APV/RNP APCH procedure with documented safety assessment and ATS authority approval.
rationale: Clause 6.7.3.4.1(d) lists permissible instrument flight procedures and their associated constraints.
exactSourceQuotes: the instrument flight procedures that align the aircraft with the extended runway centre line are any combination of the following: 1) a precision approach procedure; 2) an APV procedure designed using the RNP AR APCH navigation specification...; 3) an APV procedure designed using the RNP AR APCH navigation specification that does not meet the provisions in d) 2) or an RNP APCH, provided that: i) an appropriate, documented safety assessment has shown that an acceptable level of safety can be met; and ii) operations are approved by the appropriate ATS authority
